cards.front: What are the four functions of management?

cards.back: Setting goals and determining the best way to achieve them.
Arranging resources and tasks to accomplish organizational goals.
Motivating and directing people to achieve organizational objectives.
Monitoring performance and taking corrective action when necessary.

cards.front: What are the three levels of management?

cards.back: Assigning authority and responsibility to subordinates to complete tasks.
The number of subordinates a manager can effectively supervise.
The framework that defines how tasks are divided and coordinated.
A declaration of an organization's purpose and primary objectives.
